title: The Home Co. EG – Headless Furniture E-Commerce
tagline: Premium Next.js storefront on Shopify Storefront API
intro: Headless e-commerce for a luxury furniture brand, pairing a premium Next.js frontend with Shopify’s Storefront API.
summary: GraphQL-powered storefront with collection browsing, filters, multilingual SEO, and pixel-perfect, high-performance UI.
features: Multilingual support & SEO essentials (OG, structured data)

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A headless storefront for The Home Co EG that blends a premium, performance-oriented Next.js frontend with Shopify Storefront API.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Deliver a flexible, high-performance e-commerce experience that internal teams can manage without developer intervention.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Owned architecture and implementation; integrated Storefront API (GraphQL); configured multilingual SEO; managed VPS security & deployments; delivered pixel-perfect layouts.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Full e-commerce workflow; GraphQL product/collection data; collection filters; metaobjects-driven marketing content; SEO-first structure; performance-focused frontend.

sections.title: Challenges & Solutions
sections.body: Balanced rich visuals and animations with strict optimization budgets to keep load times low on all devices.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Modern headless architecture ready for launch; enables teams to manage content and campaigns; elevates digital brand presence.

sections.title: Future Plans
sections.body: Production launch; project-based showcases; personalization & analytics; marketing automation extensions.
